items.item_text: 01. Please list the school site(s) where you would like to work (Noon Supervisors are only assigned to elementary schools).
02. Are you interested in a district wide substitute opportunity (on-call, as needed)? Options: Yes | No
Any combination equivalent to: sufficient training and experience to demonstrate the knowledge and abilities listed above.

Assist and supervise students entering and leaving the cafeteria and while at play on the playground. Supervise students while in the cafeteria for breakfast or lunch. May assist in clean up of cafeteria after lunch. May issue citations to students failing to obey cafeteria or playground rules. Intervene, when needed, to keep students safe. Maintain good rapport with students and staff. Report pertinent information to teachers or principal. OTHER DUTIES: On rainy days, may monitor hallways by roving them to insure students are orderly in their classrooms.
